Name: Shammah the Hararite
Summary: Shammah the Hararite is named as the father of Jonathan, one of David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Shammah the Harodite and from Shammah son of Agee.
KeyStory: Shammah the Hararite fathered one of David's thirty.
LifeLesson: A Hararite father raised one of the thirty.
